coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: At the seven-variable-category level, four categories broadly match: controlled evaluation protocol, adversarial versus non-adversarial training regime, contrasting game rules, and gameplay outcomes. Model and learning-parameter variables do not match, and reasoning-performance measures only partially match.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The design fixes a smaller substitute model instead of varying LLaMA-2-7B and Baichuan-2-13B. It holds learning settings constant rather than varying learning rates and KL penalties across SPAG, imitation learning, and Alpaca SFT. It replaces geometric mean with a composite z-score and changes much of the benchmark suite. Batch size 128 and maximum sequence length 2048 are not specified.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion_output is empty, so it does not semantically match the expected conclusion that SPAG should outperform non-adversarial approaches.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion was supplied. A matching directional hypothesis in the design does not fill the empty conclusion_output field.
